Folks —

Summary for inclusion in Acme's file (short, procurement-friendly):

1) Module selection: Redwood will execute the EU Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses as Module Two (Controller-to-Processor or Exporter-to-Importer arrangement depending on customer setup) for transfers from EU and UK data subjects to Redwood processing locations. We will apply Module Two for both the EU and the UK transfers; no separate Module One/Three routing is planned.

2) Annex / safeguards: We attach SCCs_Annex_v3.pdf which documents the technical and organisational measures we implement: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM integrations), per-tenant isolation on dedicated pools where requested, role-based access controls, logging with 90-day token-level request logs (longer retention options via add-on). This Annex is intended to be included as an attachment to the executed SCCs.

3) UK nuance: The UK’s International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA) alignment is functionally equivalent for Module Two execution. For Acme's procurement checklist we can offer either: (a) a standalone UK amendment that mirrors Module Two language but references UK law, or (b) a consolidated signature block where we execute the EU SCCs and the equivalent UK text in a single document. My recommendation is option (b) — consolidated execution reduces friction for procurement and keeps parties from signing duplicate paperwork.

4) Signature & routing: We can produce a DocuSign-ready package (SCCs + Annex + Redwood DPA) and pre-fill the signing order: Acme Legal -> Redwood Authorized Signatory -> counter-signature retention mailbox. I’ll coordinate with Finance if a revenue-impacting amendment is needed.

5) Rationale (one line): Module Two is the appropriate instrument when a data exporter in the EU/UK engages a processor located outside the EU/UK to process personal data — it provides a direct contractual pathway and is accepted by procurement teams.

If no objections, I'll finalize the package and upload the DocuSign link. Neha, Lucy — suggest we send the consolidated package to Acme with the Annex and a one-page memo (Karthik: could you sign off the memo for privacy accuracy?).

-Vivek
